findings.explanation: No purchase order document exists in the evidence set even though PO-1005 is explicitly cited as a reference by both INV-1005 and REC-1005, so the authorized PO terms cannot be verified.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before its referenced invoice INV-1005 (2026-07-21), an out-of-sequence ordering that warrants review though it may reflect early goods acceptance.
